module_catalog.name: Academic information management 111
module_catalog.content: Find, evaluate, process, manage and present information resources for academic purposes using appropriate technology.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Engineering, Built Environment and Information Technology Faculty of Education Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences Faculty of Humanities Faculty of Law Faculty of Health Sciences Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences Faculty of Theology and Religion

module_catalog.name: Academic information management 121
module_catalog.content: Apply effective search strategies in different technological environments. Demonstrate the ethical and fair use of information resources. Integrate 21st-century communications into the management of academic information.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Engineering, Built Environment and Information Technology Faculty of Education Faculty of Economic and Management Sciences Faculty of Humanities Faculty of Law Faculty of Health Sciences Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences Faculty of Theology and Religion Faculty of Veterinary Science

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 121
module_catalog.content: Relevant anatomy and physiology, husbandry and handling, hospitalisation, medical nursing, surgical nursing, emergency and critical care, nutrition, common conditions, neonatal care, and anaesthesia of birds; reptiles; small mammals including rabbits, rats and mice, guinea pigs and chinchillas; primates, small carnivores, sugar gliders, hedgehogs and small wildlife. The hand rearing of wild hoof stock. Community-based practical learning takes place off-site to enable students to apply theory and develop clinical skills.
module_catalog.contact_time: 21 lectures per week for 2 weeks, 6 seminars for 2 weeks

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 122
module_catalog.content: Nursing of the patients, of the relevant domestic animals, with diseases of the skin, hooves, teat and udder. Diagnostic procedures related to the skin.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1.5 discussion classes per week for 2 weeks, 25.5 lectures per week for 2 weeks

module_catalog.name: Nursing professional life 100
module_catalog.content: Veterinary terminology and the correct usage thereof. Career paths in the veterinary nursing profession. Collegiality and professional associations, veterinary-related laws and professional ethics. Introduction to wellness management. An introduction to establishing, implementing, monitoring and evaluating sustainable quality co-operative partnerships with communities and providing consistent veterinary nursing input in order to improve animal health and welfare within a One Health Context. This theoretical background is applied practically in a community engagement activity. Opportunity to interact with professionals and community partners working in developing communities, important communication skills with people from a wide variety of backgrounds. An introduction to research methodology, including defining a research question, research design, sampling design, methods of data collection, data analysis and interpretation and report writing. Aspects of animal welfare science and animal protection applied to companion animals (cats, dogs, horses) and production animals (cattle, sheep, pigs), and human-animal interactions.
module_catalog.contact_time: 9 online lectures for 5 weeks, 12 lectures per week for 3.5 weeks, 6 practicals per week for 1 week, 6 discussion classes per week for 1 week

module_catalog.name: Language and study skills 110
module_catalog.content: The module aims to equip students with the ability to cope with the reading and writing demands of scientific disciplines.
module_catalog.contact_time: 2 lectures per week
module_catalog.service_modules: Faculty of Natural and Agricultural Sciences Faculty of Veterinary Science

module_catalog.name: Primary animal health care 110
module_catalog.content: Breeding, feeding, handling and husbandry or care of domestic animals (cats, dogs, horse, cattle, sheep, pigs). Important parasitic and infectious diseases of domestic animals, including relevant immunology, food safety and zoonotic diseases.
module_catalog.contact_time: 24 lectures per week for 5 weeks, 4 practicals per week for 5 weeks

module_catalog.name: Veterinary nursing practice 110
module_catalog.content: Essential nursing practices including disinfection and hospital hygiene, hospitalisation, basic nursing practices, observation and clinical examination of patients and occupational safety aspects. Fundamental pharmacology including medicine administration, storage and handling, drug regulations, dispensing, calculations, pharmacotherapeutics, pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics. The pharmacology of organ systems.
module_catalog.contact_time: 4 practicals per week for 3 weeks, 20 lectures per week for 3 weeks

module_catalog.name: Veterinary nursing practice 120
module_catalog.content: Diagnostic procedures involving veterinary nurses, including diagnostic imaging, clinical pathology and other laboratory test, sample taking and sample management. Introduction to the general principles of animal physical rehabilitation procedures.
module_catalog.contact_time: 17 lectures per week for 3.5 weeks, 1 discussion class per week, 2,5 practicals per week for 2 weeks

module_catalog.name: Foundational veterinary sciences 110
module_catalog.content: Introductory anatomy, histology and physiology of the dog, cat, horse and ruminant. Applied ethology and communication of domestic animals (cats, dogs, horses, cattle, sheep, and pigs).
module_catalog.contact_time: 25 lectures per week, 4 weeks, 1 discussion class per week for 3 weeks

module_catalog.name: Foundational veterinary sciences 120
module_catalog.content: Anatomy and physiology of the organ systems of the dog, cat, horse and ruminant.
module_catalog.contact_time: 25.5 lectures per week for 4 weeks

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 211
module_catalog.content: Nursing and physical rehabilitation of musculo-skeletal patients of the relevant domestic animals. Diagnostic imaging of the skeleton.  Principles of theatre practice.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 3 practicals per week over 4 weeks, 20 lectures per week for 4 weeks

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 212
module_catalog.content: Nursing of patients, of the relevant domestic animals, with dental and gastrointestinal diseases. Diagnostic Imaging of the abdomen. Other diagnostic procedures related to the gastro-intestinal tract.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 3 practicals per week over 2 weeks, 24 lectures per week for 2 weeks

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 213
module_catalog.content: Nursing of patients, of the relevant domestic animals, with reproductive conditions. Care and nursing of neonates. Assisted reproduction technologies.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 6 practicals per week for 2 weeks, 21 lectures per week for 2 weeks, 3 online lectures for 2 weeks

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 214
module_catalog.content: Nursing of the patient with endocrine disease, of the relevant domestic animals. Nursing of urinary and renal patients. Diagnostic procedures related to the endocrine system, bladder and kidneys.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1.5 practicals per week for 2 weeks, 1 discussion class per week over 2 weeks, 16 lectures per week for 2 weeks

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 221
module_catalog.content: Nursing of ophthalmological and neurological patients, of the relevant domestic animals. Diagnostic imaging of the skull and spine. Diagnostic procedures related to the eye and nervous system.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1.5 online lecture for 1 week, 22 lectures per week for 2 weeks

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 222
module_catalog.content: Nursing of cardiac and respiratory patients, of the relevant domestic animals.  Anaesthesiology of the veterinary patient. Diagnostic imaging of the thorax. Other diagnostic procedures related to the cardio-vascular and respiratory system. Physical animal rehabilitation related to the circulatory and respiratory systems.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 19 lectures per week for 4 weeks, 2 practicals per week for 4  weeks, 1.5 online lecture for 4 weeks

module_catalog.name: Clinical veterinary nursing 223
module_catalog.content: Critical care of patients, of the relevant domestic animals. Nursing of the oncology patient. Nursing of a patient with multi-systemic disease. Triage and emergencies.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 1.25 practicals per week for 4 weeks, 1.25 online lecture, 4 weeks, 20 lectures per week for 4 weeks

module_catalog.name: Nursing professional life 210
module_catalog.content: Communication for veterinary nurses. Self-awareness, self-management, social awareness, professionalism, gender based violence and relationship management. Cultural diversity. Information management. Practice management for veterinary nurses, including relevant marketing, promotion and sales, human resources management work place discipline, rewards for good work performance and application of the Labour Law in the work place, strategic client service and management, compassion fatigue and its components. Continuation of a portfolio as evidence of learning.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 23 lectures per week for 2 weeks, 1.5 other contact session per week, 3 discussion classes per week over 2 weeks

module_catalog.name: Veterinary nursing practice 200
module_catalog.content: Experiential learning: a practical application of the theoretical aspects of veterinary nursing practice. Experiential learning and experience will be gained by means of the Onderstepoort Skills Laboratory and limited exposure to clinic rotations in the Onderstepoort Veterinary Academic Hospital.
module_catalog.prerequisites: Admission into relevant programme and Second year academic level.
module_catalog.contact_time: 7.5 clinical practicals per week for 12 weeks, Yes
